title: Elysian Band — Grand
subtitle: The Elysian Cut™ set full circle — an elongated light that never closes.

stone.origin: Natural. Full eternity. Bez Ambar proprietary elongated cut.

description: The Elysian Cut™ — Bez Ambar's proprietary elongated form, falling between an oval and a baguette and shaped for a light all its own — set full circle in eighteen-karat white gold. At its grandest proportion the stones command the hand outright, each elongated facet throwing light in long, deliberate sweeps around an unbroken eternity. It is the fullest statement of the cut: nothing held back, the circle complete. Made as a full band, with a halfway version available on request.
